title: AMBA AXI3 subordinate: a 256-word memory, INCR and FIXED bursts of up to 16 beats with byte strobes and WID, independent read and write paths, SLVERR and DECERR responses

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: a transfer got SLVERR or DECERR, or a write burst's WLAST came early or not at all, or a WID did not match the AWID; the core holds this until reset, so the bit cannot be cleared before then

notes: The AW, W, B, AR and R channel pins (awid ... rready, with wid) are the AXI3 subordinate pins; they pass through unchanged. The registers report the subordinate's error event.

One transaction at a time per direction, any ID, no write interleaving. DECERR: a size above 4 bytes or the reserved burst type. SLVERR: a burst starting outside bytes 0x000 to 0x3FF or misaligned, a WRAP burst, an INCR burst running past 0x3FF (from that beat on), a WID other than the AWID, a WLAST early or missing. Writes are dropped from the first error on.
